label: TP
reason: User input from request.getParameter() flows directly to response.getWriter().write() without proper sanitization. The StringBuilder.replace() operation only modifies the last character to 'Z' which does not prevent XSS attacks (e.g., <script> tags, javascript: URLs remain intact). No HTML escaping or context-aware filtering is applied.

evidence.note: User input param flows through StringBuilder.replace() (which only changes last char to Z) then directly to getWriter().write() without XSS prevention
